'''A Very Important Thing''' (Japanese: '''大切ですごいもの''' ''A Very Important Thing'') is the third chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* With the power of {{p|Zekrom}}, no-one can stand in the way of [[N]] as he defeats the Elite Four and destroys the Pokémon League, however the [[Alder|Champion]] goes missing.
* Shin meets an [[Alder|old man passing by]], who is looking for something.
* After finding it, they reveal their name and position—Champion of the Pokémon League, Alder.
